action: Place the probe in the left epigastrium.
interpretation: Locate and visualize the stomach in the left epigastrium.

action: Inspect the stomach wall and lumen. Scan towards the pillars.
interpretation: Identify the walling of the stomach and air within the lumen. Note that the walling becomes thicker as the structure extends towards the pillars.

action: Advance the scan to the next consecutive structure.
Analyze the composition of the duodenum.
interpretation: Visualize an air structure with subtle walling. Note that the walling becomes less muscular compared to previous structures.

action: Slide the probe downwards to the center of the view.
interpretation: Locate the head of the pancreas in the center of the image.

action: Maneuver the probe around to the lower side of the epigastrium.
interpretation: Find the jejunum and small intestine segments.

action: Observe the movement of the small intestine structures.
interpretation: Note that peristalsis is rather diminished and the structures are not really moving, consistent with the patient not having eaten.

action: Instruct patient: 'Hold your breath'. Focus on the bowel loop.
interpretation: Confirm that the peristalsis is very subtle.

action: Move the probe down lower and slide over to the right lower quadrant of the abdomen.
interpretation: Locate the ileum, the third part of the small intestine.
Observe that there is not very much peristalsis present.

action: Move the probe to the outer right side of the lower abdomen.
interpretation: Identify an air-filled structure with very subtle, less distinct walling. Recognize this as the ascending colon and the cecum.

action: Slide the probe superiorly to the right upper quadrant. Instruct patient: 'Take a deep breath and hold it'.
Tilt the probe and follow the continuous structure through the middle abdomen to the contralateral side.
interpretation: Trace the air structure across the abdomen. Identify the transverse colon crossing to the other side.

action: Instruct patient: 'Exhale again'. Then instruct: 'Take a deep breath again'.
interpretation: Prepare to visualize the left upper quadrant structures.
Visualize the left colonic flexure going around.

action: Tilt the probe to obtain a cross-section. Slide down along the flank to follow the descending colon to the sigmoid colon.
interpretation: Visualize the descending colon in cross-section. Trace it down until it transitions to the sigmoid colon moving toward the middle in cross-section.

action: Adjust orientation for cross-section and scan inferiorly.
interpretation: Follow the sigmoid colon as it goes over into the rectum.

action: Angle the probe inferiorly to look behind the bladder.
interpretation: Visualize the rectum located behind the bladder.
